preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip()])
preconditions.description: All input values are positive integers. The first line is T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10), followed by T test cases. Each test case starts with N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5), followed by N integers A_i (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^4).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2])
preconditions.description: Each test case's second line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((output == '-1') or (output == str(max(2 * N, sum(A_i) - (N - 2)))) for A_i, output in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if it is impossible to pick at least two units of each type (i.e., N > 1 and any A_i < 2), output is -1. Otherwise, the output is the maximum number of picks needed in the worst case, which is the maximum between 2*N (to guarantee two of each type) and the total items minus (N - 2) (to account for the worst-case scenario where all but two types are picked first).

postconditions.expression: all((output == '-1') == (N > 1 and any(A_i < 2 for A_i in A)) for A, output in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Output is -1 if and only if there exists at least one ingredient type with fewer than 2 units (and N > 1).
